# Daily Briefing – Friday 10 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training logged and just 4,861 steps, though your body still burned 2,337 kcal, which is spot on for your daily target. The real story is the sleep: 4.9 hours simply isn't enough to support your goals, and your HRV of 91ms reflects that, sitting below your 102–119ms baseline. Your stress at 41/100 is manageable, but combined with that sleep debt, your body is waving a small yellow flag.

With HRV suppressed like this, today isn't the day to push hard. Keep any session aerobic and easy — think a gentle 30-minute jog or brisk walk. Forcing intensity on poor sleep adds fatigue without fitness gains.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything. Aim for 8 hours — it'll do more for your Chester prep than any extra session. Hit your 175g protein today to protect muscle while in a calorie deficit.
